data.title: Array iteration regression test — 3 independent single-theme challenges (expected: 3 separate Standard rows, each single-themed, no delimiter splitting)
challenges: Our school children are not given books on time.
There is a shortage of teachers in the school, due to which subject-wise studies are not done.
The school is very far from the village.
solutions: Ensuring books are distributed to students at the start of the academic year.
Recruiting additional subject teachers to cover the shortage.
Arranging safe transportation for students from distant villages.
